reckoning.method: Point estimate = midpoint of the range. Range = the latest projected crossing window among pending conditions (condition 8: 2028 under LBNL high case; 2033 extrapolating LBNL low case at 8.77%/yr relative growth). Crossing pace of met conditions: 6 in 2.25 years = 2.67/yr.

conditions.title: Machines outnumber humans on the web
One AI product passes a billion weekly users
conditions.evidence: ChatGPT 1.2B weekly users stated Oct 2026; crossing ~May 2026 interpolated between official statements (900M Feb 2026, 1.2B Oct 2026)

index.name: BRAIAIN Buildout Index
index.definition: Big-4 hyperscaler capital expenditure plus NVIDIA data-center revenue, per calendar quarter, indexed to Q3 2025 = 100. NVIDIA fiscal quarters run ~1 month behind calendar quarters; see methodology.
index.since_base_note: three quarters, Q3 2025 to Q2 2026 — not a year-over-year figure

flows.buildout_flow_note: Combined flow of two books: chips the Big-4 buy from NVIDIA appear in both their capex and NVIDIA's revenue; not de-duplicated spending
flows.capex_label: Total capital expenditures as filed; companies describe the growth as AI/cloud-driven but do not report an AI line item.
